title: Build output in a loop
prompt: Implement `String evens(int n)`: return the even numbers 2, 4, ..., 2n joined by ", " — e.g. `evens(3)` returns "2, 4, 6". Accumulate into a String; add ", " **before** each item except the first.

tests.name: comma separated
tests.hint: Guard: separator goes in only when the string is non-empty (or track an index).
